name: parallel-investigation
intent: Fan out one researcher per angle in parallel, then synthesize a single cited brief.
whenToUse: A question needs several independent angles (docs, implementation, examples, risks) before one answer is trustworthy.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: The question the brief must answer.

inputs.name: angles
inputs.description: Investigation angles. Defaults to docs, implementation, examples and risks.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: Extra instruction for the synthesizer, e.g. length or audience.

phases.title: Investigate
phases.detail: One researcher per angle, running concurrently.

phases.title: Synthesize
phases.detail: One agent turns the findings into a cited brief.
